notes: GrounDiff conditioned on the lasground_new result, predicting the EA hand-edited DTM. The gate surface s is the lasground_new DTM, so Eq. 5 keeps it where no edit is needed and the confidence head (Eq. 14, M_alpha = |dtm_before - gt| < alpha) learns 'no edit needed': 1 - sigmoid(l) is the per-pixel edit probability. Extra inputs follow ALS2DTM/DeepTerRa (Le et al. 2022): lowest-return rasters, statistic rasters (density, z_std, echoes) and the 2-channel ground/non-ground raster (their 'sem2'), here from lasground_new classes. Empty cells are nearest-filled and the loss covers them (the EA DTM is complete).
